current_content_summary: Type ('a,'b) fmap (finite-domain partial maps) is built on top of SmtMap's total-map type via a tomap/ofmap isomorphism to ('a, 'b option) map (tomapK/ofmapK/isfmap_offmap are the defining axioms). Core API: get/set notations `.[_]`/`.[_ <- _]`, dom/rng, empty, rem, fmap_eqP (extensionality), eq_except (per-key equality outside a predicate set X -- used heavily in ROM/PRF-style up-to-bad arguments), map/filter (functorial map and predicate filter), fdom/frng (the DOMAIN and RANGE of a map AS AN FSet.fset -- this is the fmap/FSet integration point), fmapW (structural induction principle via fdom), the `+` operator (right-biased map union/override), has/find/find_spec (search a map for a key/value pair satisfying a predicate), ofassoc (build a map from an association list), fsize (= FSet.card (fdom m)), fcoll (whether two distinct keys collide under some function f -- used by PROM's collision-bound lemma), and a block of 'flagged map' helpers (restr/noflags/in_dom_with/bounded) plus merge/union_map/pair_map for combining two maps pointwise. This is a large, actively-used API surface -- the single most import-repair-relevant library of the nine, alongside SmtMap.
